events.label: withdrawal
events.text: All seven US Army locomotives in Alaska and Yukon withdrawn from service.

evidence.quote: All seven were withdrawn from service in 1944

events.label: scrapping
events.text: Seven withdrawn US Army locomotives barged to Seattle for scrapping.
